stem: A resident is asked how to choose among systemic fluoride and in-office or home topical fluoride products for a child. Which approach is most consistent with AAPD guidance?

options.text: Select products based on the individual patient's specific needs, whether delivered in the office or at home.
Use one standard fluoride product for every patient regardless of individual needs.
Base dietary fluoride supplement decisions on the child's age alone.
Defer fluoridated toothpaste until professionally applied agents have been given.
Avoid fluoridated toothpaste in patients with special health care needs.
